title: Hospitals in England brace for flu spike with admissions highest since pre-Covid
summary_full: NHS boss says hospital bosses should consider asking staff and visitors to wear masks as winter pressures buildHospitals are bracing for a “horrible spike” in flu in the coming days as winter starts to bite, the head of the NHS in England has said.Flu and other winter viruses including Covid pose such a threat that hospital bosses should consider telling staff and visitors to wear masks, Jim Mackey said, as figures showed rates of admissions to hospital with flu were at the highest for the time of year since before Covid.
